area: Timing from the looks (step 4 of the READ ME): when in a bet's life the price is best and the close most often beaten; trap vs gift for long-listed bets; liquidity across looks; first price vs best/last/wait/limit rules
trust_notes: TRUST: (1) The sample for CLV is the 683 bets (33% of 2080) with a close, in 69 games, from 2.26 days of first looks; the 1397 without a close are mostly games not yet played (Oct 6-12) and bets whose close source had nothing (props without a Pinnacle close, Novig trades under 30 min). A close needs a finished game, so every bet with one was first seen at most 3018 min (50 h) before its start: the >24 h bucket has 331 bets and only 15 closes, and nothing is known about it beyond 'thin'. (2) CLV at a look is closeFair / implied price at that look - 1 (no fee pregame), exactly the loader's definition at the first look (checked to 1e-16 on 683 bets). Look-level CLV uses only price looks (kinds c, w, v, k; 9 looks have a negative minToStart and are dropped). The c, w and v quotes of the same minute agree 98.9% (c/w), 93% (v/w) and 95% (v/c), so 'BEST' is slightly flattered by cross-source quote noise (restricted to one source BEST-minus-FIRST is +0.47 to +1.05 pts instead of +1.10); it is a hindsight ceiling anyway. (3) Closes are mixed: Tracker (CNO's own consensus read before the start, 228), Novig's last trades (341, which is Novig's own late price: CLV against it is about -0.2% pooled and near 0 at every lead time), ESPN/DraftKings (97), Pinnacle (17). The timing gap is carried by the Tracker and ESPN closes (+3.3 and +2.1 pts) and is small and not significant against Novig trades (+0.5 pts). (4) 'Still listed' is half censored: at 30 minutes after the first look 533 bets are listed, 718 dropped and 413 unobserved (no look within 10 min and no drop: the app was not logging); every survival and 'wait' number counts only observed states. 809 of 2080 bets drop and later reappear. (5) Left truncation: 34% of bets (715; first looks in the study's first 6 h) are listings that already existed when logging began, and 71% of the Oct 3 bets are early ones; the early-minus-late gap falls to +1.16 pts (CI -0.46 to +2.91) without them, though 3 of 4 strata by hours since the study began still show +2.0 to +2.8 pts (the 6-24 h stratum +0.7). (6) The two date halves: first looks on Oct 3 (373 closes, 54 games) and Oct 4-5 (310 closes, 36 games); the loader's own cut falls on Oct 4 and leaves only 65 closes in its second half, so every rule also carries the balanced cut. Second-half intervals are wide. (7) Policies are evaluated on the prices that were LISTED (the bet still passed the list's filters): any 'wait for an improvement' rule is selected on a still-positive EV, which is how the app would see it live, but it is not a limit order at a fixed price. (8) Same-game bets are correlated, so every interval resamples games (2000 draws, the loader's bootstrap); several analyses were run (cut points, close sources, subsets): the primary comparison (<=6 h vs >6 h) was fixed by the guard before this analysis and replicates RESEARCH.md §82, the others are descriptive. (9) Dollars is the dollars at the current price level, so a repricing resets it.
key_numbers: Sample: 2080 bets in 190 games, 47751 looks over 2.26 days of first-looks; only 683 bets (69 games) have a close (588 close_ok), so every CLV figure here rests on about 683 bets in about 69 games; the date-balanced halves are first-looks on Oct 3 (373 closes, 54 games) and Oct 4-5 (310 closes, 36 games).

First look within 6 h of the start: CLV +1.41% (95% CI +1.01% to +2.00%) on 256 closes (66 games; 938 bets, 416 a day); first look more than 6 h out: -0.54% (95% CI -1.57% to +0.35%) on 427 closes (31 games; 1142 bets, 506 a day, 55% of all bets).

The early-minus-late gap is +1.95 pts (95% CI +1.05 pts to +2.96 pts); bootstrap over games: 0 of 10000 resamples at or below zero. On the date-balanced halves: +2.17 pts (+0.98 pts to +3.47 pts; 76 vs 297 closes) then +1.09 pts (-0.60 pts to +2.89 pts; 180 vs 130): same sign twice, the second half's interval includes 0.

Inside the same game (28 games that have closed bets on both sides of 6 h): bets first seen within 6 h beat the close by +2.62 pts more than the same game's earlier bets (95% CI +1.39 pts to +3.86 pts); 82% of the games point the same way.

CLV at the first price by minutes-before-start bucket (closes in brackets): <30m +1.40% (86); 30-60m +0.32% (33); 1-3h +1.69% (91); 3-6h +1.65% (46); 6-12h +0.19% (98); 12-24h -0.55% (314); >24h -5.07% (15). Flat at +1.0 to +1.7% from 3-6 h to the start, about 0 at 6-12 h, -0.55% at 12-24 h (314 closes, 28 games), -5.07% beyond 24 h (15 closes, 5 games: thin).

Look-level CLV (the CLV you would have got at each look, one value per bet and bucket, all closes): <30m +1.00% (242 bets, 54 games); 30-60m +0.94% (96 bets, 31 games); 1-3h +1.05% (213 bets, 49 games); 3-6h +0.63% (113 bets, 25 games); 6-12h +0.00% (258 bets, 26 games); 12-24h -0.60% (325 bets, 29 games); >24h -5.12% (15 bets, 5 games): the same shape at look level (early looks of a bet are worse than its later ones, see the paired table).

Same bets, later price: for the 63 bets listed at 12-24 h AND again under 30 min, the later price beats the close by +1.68 pts more (+0.72 pts to +2.84 pts, 19 games); for the 96 listed at 1-3 h and under 30 min +0.50 pts (+0.13 pts to +0.79 pts, 30 games). These are survivors (still listed), so it is not a free option.

63% of bets never change price while listed; of the 774 that do, 56% end at a better price than the first look and 33% at a worse one. Over all 683 closed bets: FIRST price +0.19% (95% CI -0.34% to +0.78%); LAST listed price +0.61% (95% CI +0.18% to +1.08%); BEST price ever listed (hindsight ceiling) +1.30% (95% CI +0.88% to +1.76%).

Take the first listed price once the bet is inside 6 h (ENTER_360, the equivalent of the trap guard's window for an auto-bet): 1225 bets (543 a day, 59% of all), 422 closes, 67 games, CLV +0.88% (95% CI +0.54% to +1.30%) against +0.40% for the same bets taken at their first look: +0.47 pts (+0.21 pts to +0.77 pts); both halves positive (+0.69 pts, +0.31 pts).

Trap or gift by what the price did later: price lengthened afterwards (the line moved against the bet): first-price CLV -2.25% (95% CI -3.17% to -1.16%) on 193 closes (40 games), only 35% beat the close, while its LAST price is +0.90%; price shortened afterwards (a gift): +2.16% (95% CI +1.58% to +2.89%) on 117 closes, 74% beat; unchanged +0.84% (95% CI +0.29% to +1.39%) on 373. Novig's price follows the fair with slope 0.86 (CI 0.78 to 0.94); the fair's later move carries 0.90 (CI 0.78 to 1.00) of itself into the close.

A bet that stays listed a long time is a trap only when it was listed early: listedMin 360+ min -1.38% (95% CI -2.48% to -0.19%) on 144 closes (24 games); among bets first seen 12 h or more out, those that lived 6 h or more closed 1.44 pts worse than shorter-lived ones (difference -1.44 pts, CI -2.54 pts to -0.29 pts; 177 vs 152 closes, 30 games). Among bets first seen within 6 h there is no life effect (<5 min +1.33%, 5-60 min +1.58%, 1-6 h +1.27%).

EV rising or falling across the looks carries no independent signal: EV fell +0.53% (193 closes), rose -0.42% (194), flat +0.37% (296), every CI includes 0; the groups differ mainly in their first-look EV (+2.19% vs +0.82%), inside 6 h they are +1.47%, +1.45%, +1.35%.

Listed EV is worth more the closer the start: CLV minus listed EV is <30m -0.18 pts, 30-60m -1.29 pts, 1-3h -0.12 pts, 3-6h -0.11 pts, 6-12h -1.10 pts, 12-24h -2.20 pts, >24h -6.03 pts; the fair drifts away from the listed fair by -1.06 pts on average at 12-24 h (CI -1.41 pts to -0.73 pts, 314 closes) vs -0.27 pts under 1 h, with a spread of 3.0 vs 1.5 points (winner's curse on an early, noisier consensus).

Within 6 h, CLV climbs with the listed EV (+0.76% under 1.5%, +1.32% at 1.5-2.5%, +2.43% at 2.5-4%, +4.05% at 4%+ on 23 bets / 15 games); beyond 12 h it is -1.34%, -0.35%, +0.01%, +1.13% (the 4%+ cell: 26 bets, 12 games, CI -3.00% to +5.02%).

Waiting inside the 6 h window gains nothing: LAST price vs FIRST on the 256 closed bets first seen within 6 h is -0.06 pts (CI -0.28 to +0.25), a 5/15/30-min delay after the first look moves CLV by -0.02 to +0.08 pts (60 min: +0.74 pts, CI +0.04 to +2.47, on 27 closes), and the BEST price ever listed is +0.69 pts above FIRST (hindsight ceiling).

'Bid for a better price' inside 6 h: the 108 bets (12%) whose price later improved by 1% or more while still listed would have been taken at +2.27% (95% CI +1.35% to +3.81%) (51 closes, 25 games) vs -0.26% at their first price (same bets); second half +2.29% on 40, first half +2.20% on 11.

Liquidity does not decay for most bets: median Novig dollars at the price is unchanged (1.00x of the first look after 60 min), but 13% / 25% / 37% / 42% / 44% of listed bets have fewer dollars after 5 / 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 min (and 5% to 15% more); median available at first look is $72 (IQR $18 to $289), $58 inside 6 h.

findings.claim: CLV at the first-listed price is a step function of time to the start, not a slope: about +1.0 to +1.7% from 3-6 h to the start, about 0 at 6-12 h, negative at 12-24 h, and -5% beyond 24 h; the break is near 6 h, which is where the app's trap guard already sits.
findings.luck_risk: Low: bootstrap over games gave 0 of 10000 resamples with the gap at or below zero, and it replicates RESEARCH.md §82 (a different, overlapping set: Tj's own placed bets, +3.0% within 6 h vs -0.5% beyond, 418 closes), so the 6 h cut was a prior, not a fitted threshold. Only 31 games sit on the early side, 15 of them NFL Sunday, and the second half's CI includes 0; cut points 3/6/12 h give +1.67/+1.95/+1.83 pts, so the exact cut is not resolved between 3 and 12 h.

findings.claim: The early-vs-late gap holds inside the same game, so it is not just 'NFL Sunday props are bad'.
findings.evidence: 28 games have closed bets both within 6 h and beyond 6 h; the game-level mean of (late - early) is +2.62 pts (CI +1.39 pts to +3.86 pts), 82% of games positive; first-look half 20 games +2.49 pts, second half 8 games +2.96 pts. Subsets (late minus early, pts): props +2.15 (149/328 closes), non-props +1.65 (107/99), NFL +1.75, non-NFL +1.98, shown +2.09, hidden +1.89.
findings.effect: +2.62 pts (95% CI +1.39 pts to +3.86 pts) over 28 games
findings.luck_risk: Low; 28 games is a small cluster count, but 23 of 28 point the same way (binomial p about 0.001 against a coin flip).

findings.claim: The gap shows against the Tracker (CNO consensus) and ESPN/DraftKings closes but not against Novig's own last trades, which is what you would expect if early Novig prices are right about Novig's own later price and wrong about the books' move; it also shrinks when the study's first hours are dropped.
findings.evidence: Late minus early by close source: tracker +3.26 pts (+1.65 pts to +4.90 pts, 101/127 closes), ESPN +2.14 pts (+0.98 pts to +3.46 pts, 54/43), Novig trades +0.54 pts (-0.83 pts to +1.78 pts, 95/246). Pinnacle closes: 17 in all, too few. Bets Tj placed (Tracker closes, 101/128 closes): +3.21 pts (+1.63 pts to +4.86 pts); bets he did not place (155/299 closes: Novig trades, ESPN, Pinnacle): +1.19 pts (+0.17 pts to +2.22 pts), of which the ESPN/Pinnacle ones (60/53): +2.34 pts (+1.13 pts to +3.41 pts). Dropping bets first seen in the first 6 h of the study (left-truncated: listings that already existed when logging began): +1.16 pts (-0.46 pts to +2.91 pts; 180/133 closes); dropping the first hour only: +1.94 pts.
findings.effect: tracker +3.26 pts, ESPN +2.14 pts, Novig trades +0.54 pts (CI includes 0)
findings.luck_risk: Moderate for the size (1.1 to 3.3 pts depending on close and sample), low for the sign. The Tracker close is CNO's own consensus (the same books that made the EV), a weaker yardstick than Pinnacle's.

findings.claim: Why early bets lose to the close: the consensus fair the EV is built from drifts further, and more noisily, before it settles, and the bet was selected for a positive EV (winner's curse); Novig's price follows that fair.
findings.evidence: Close fair minus listed fair at the first look: <1h -0.27 pts [-0.59 pts, +0.07 pts] sd 1.5 pts on 119; 1-3h -0.11 pts [-0.42 pts, +0.37 pts] sd 2.1 pts on 92; 3-6h -0.08 pts [-0.42 pts, +0.31 pts] sd 1.4 pts on 45; 6-12h -0.59 pts [-1.40 pts, +0.59 pts] sd 3.8 pts on 98; 12-24h -1.06 pts [-1.41 pts, -0.73 pts] sd 3.0 pts on 314; >24h -2.89 pts [-3.65 pts, -0.38 pts] sd 3.4 pts on 15. Slopes (game-cluster bootstrap): CLV on first-look EV 0.66 (CI 0.25 to 1.07); (closeFair - first fair) on (last fair - first fair) 0.90 (CI 0.78 to 1.00); Novig's implied price change on the fair change 0.86 (CI 0.78 to 0.94). CLV minus listed EV by bucket: <30m -0.18 pts, 30-60m -1.29 pts, 1-3h -0.12 pts, 3-6h -0.11 pts, 6-12h -1.10 pts, 12-24h -2.20 pts, >24h -6.03 pts.
findings.effect: 12-24h bias -1.06 pts (CI -1.41 pts to -0.73 pts); within 6 h -0.27 pts to -0.08 pts
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: the mechanism is inferred from the drift numbers, not tested directly; the 12-24 h and >24 h biases are clearly negative, the 6-12 h one (-0.59 pts, 98 closes, 24 games) is not separated from 0.

findings.claim: Inside 6 h the listed EV is almost fully kept and CLV rises with it; beyond 12 h it takes 4%+ listed EV to reach about +1%, on a handful of bets.
findings.luck_risk: Moderate-high for the within-6 h EV gradient (cells of 23-152 bets, the 4%+ cell's CI is +2.0 to +6.6); the >12 h 4%+ cell (26 bets, 12 games) cannot be told from 0. Cells were cut once, not searched.

findings.claim: Within a bet's life, the price at a later look beats the close by more than the same bet's earlier price, but only for bets that are still listed (survivors), and the gain is concentrated in the last hours.
findings.evidence: Paired within-bet differences in look-level CLV (later bucket minus earlier, pts): 12-24h-><30m: +1.68 pts [+0.72 pts, +2.84 pts] on 63 bets/19 games, later better in 62%, same in 13%; 12-24h->1-3h: +1.41 pts [+0.39 pts, +2.55 pts] on 67 bets/20 games, later better in 48%, same in 21%; 12-24h->6-12h: +0.64 pts [+0.33 pts, +1.15 pts] on 159 bets/20 games, later better in 45%, same in 31%; 6-12h->1-3h: +0.41 pts [-0.21 pts, +0.96 pts] on 73 bets/20 games, later better in 44%, same in 26%; 6-12h-><30m: +1.30 pts [+0.48 pts, +2.13 pts] on 66 bets/19 games, later better in 62%, same in 15%; 3-6h-><30m: +0.72 pts [-1.20 pts, +1.80 pts] on 33 bets/12 games, later better in 61%, same in 9%; 1-3h-><30m: +0.50 pts [+0.13 pts, +0.79 pts] on 96 bets/30 games, later better in 42%, same in 28%; 1-3h->30-60m: +0.46 pts [-0.01 pts, +1.38 pts] on 58 bets/19 games, later better in 45%, same in 36%; >24h-><30m: +9.73 pts [+7.63 pts, +11.13 pts] on 5 bets/2 games, later better in 100%, same in 0%. By half (12-24h -> <30m): first half +1.18 pts (52 bets), second half +4.06 pts (11 bets). Price vs the first look, lengthening by first-look bucket (mean first/last price gain in implied probability): <30m -0.04% (best +0.18%, 15% change); 30-60m +0.01% (best +0.30%, 28% change); 1-3h +0.00% (best +0.58%, 36% change); 3-6h +0.03% (best +0.64%, 39% change); 6-12h +0.66% (best +1.07%, 44% change); 12-24h +0.50% (best +1.00%, 44% change); >24h +0.97% (best +1.63%, 50% change).
findings.effect: 12-24h -> <30m +1.68 pts (CI +0.72 pts to +2.84 pts), 63 bets/19 games
findings.luck_risk: Low-moderate: sign repeats on both halves; the second-half cells are 8-13 games. Not a tradeable gain by itself because the bets that vanish from the list are not counted.

findings.claim: Hindsight timing is worth a lot, realistic timing is worth little: taking the BEST price ever listed would add about +1.1 pts of CLV, the LAST listed price +0.4 pts, and the rules that can be run live (enter at 6 h, delay, wait for a price at least as good) add 0.1 to 0.7 pts on the bets they keep while dropping 40-85% of the bets.
findings.evidence: Policies over the 683 closed bets: FIRST: +0.19% [-0.34%, +0.78%] on 683 closes/69 games, same bets at first look +0.19%, gain -0.00 pts [-0.01 pts, +0.00 pts], 922 bets/day, halves -0.52%|+1.03%; LAST: +0.61% [+0.18%, +1.08%] on 683 closes/69 games, same bets at first look +0.19%, gain +0.42 pts [+0.19 pts, +0.68 pts], 922 bets/day, halves +0.00%|+1.34%; BEST: +1.30% [+0.88%, +1.76%] on 683 closes/69 games, same bets at first look +0.19%, gain +1.10 pts [+0.86 pts, +1.39 pts], 922 bets/day, halves +0.66%|+2.06%; ENTER_360: +0.88% [+0.54%, +1.30%] on 422 closes/67 games, same bets at first look +0.40%, gain +0.47 pts [+0.21 pts, +0.77 pts], 543 bets/day, halves +0.28%|+1.33%; ENTER_180: +0.92% [+0.64%, +1.34%] on 380 closes/63 games, same bets at first look +0.46%, gain +0.46 pts [+0.18 pts, +0.76 pts], 485 bets/day, halves +0.47%|+1.24%; ENTER_60: +0.91% [+0.58%, +1.34%] on 286 closes/57 games, same bets at first look +0.29%, gain +0.62 pts [+0.27 pts, +0.93 pts], 365 bets/day, halves +0.53%|+1.17%; ENTER_30: +0.94% [+0.59%, +1.38%] on 245 closes/54 games, same bets at first look +0.23%, gain +0.71 pts [+0.29 pts, +1.10 pts], 313 bets/day, halves +0.51%|+1.25%. WAIT_Y_ge_first (wait until Y min before the start, take it only if still listed at a price at least the first): Y=360: 1013 of 2080 bets kept, 296 closes, CLV +1.19% vs +1.00% at first look (gain +0.19 pts [+0.04 pts, +0.36 pts]); Y=180: 847 of 2080 bets kept, 241 closes, CLV +1.19% vs +1.00% at first look (gain +0.19 pts [+0.05 pts, +0.43 pts]); Y=60: 578 of 2080 bets kept, 152 closes, CLV +1.10% vs +0.90% at first look (gain +0.20 pts [+0.06 pts, +0.37 pts]); Y=30: 495 of 2080 bets kept, 125 closes, CLV +1.15% vs +0.41% at first look (gain +0.73 pts [+0.13 pts, +1.36 pts]); Y=15: 408 of 2080 bets kept, 115 closes, CLV +1.36% vs +0.35% at first look (gain +1.01 pts [+0.45 pts, +1.46 pts]); Y=5: 320 of 2080 bets kept, 106 closes, CLV +1.47% vs +0.03% at first look (gain +1.44 pts [+0.65 pts, +2.22 pts]). First look at least X min before the start (a filter on minToStartFirst, FIRST_if_m0>=X): X=30: +0.01% on 597 closes; X=60: -0.00% on 564 closes; X=180: -0.33% on 473 closes; X=360: -0.54% on 427 closes (requiring lead time removes the bets that do best). Unit-stake CLV total on the closes (sum of CLV): FIRST 1.3u, ENTER_360 3.7u, ENTER_30 2.3u, LAST 4.2u, BEST 8.9u.
findings.effect: ENTER_360 vs FIRST on the same bets: +0.47 pts (CI +0.21 pts to +0.77 pts)
findings.luck_risk: Low for 'ENTER_360 beats FIRST' (both halves positive: +0.69, +0.31 pts); the ranking among ENTER_x and WAIT_x variants is noise (differences of 0.1 pts, CIs overlap). ROI at the policy price is +1.6% (FIRST), +3.2% (ENTER_360) with intervals of +-4 to +8 points: no ROI conclusion.

findings.claim: 'Wait for a better price' costs more bets than it earns: a bet that is still listed 30 minutes before the start at a price at least as good is only 24% of all bets.
findings.evidence: WAIT_30_ge_first keeps 495 of 2080 bets (24%), 125 closes, 48 games: CLV +1.15% (95% CI +0.53% to +1.94%) vs +0.41% at their first look, gain +0.73 pts (+0.13 pts to +1.36 pts). The same bets' total CLV is about equal to FIRST's total on all closes (1.4u vs 1.3u), i.e. what waiting gains per bet it loses in bets.
findings.effect: +0.73 pts on 125 closes, but 76% of bets dropped
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: depends on which bets are 'still listed', a state that is half censored (see trust_notes).

findings.claim: Whether a bet was a trap or a gift is mostly what the price did afterwards: bets whose price later LENGTHENED lost to the close at their first price (a trap), bets whose price later SHORTENED beat it (a gift). The later price recovers the trap.
findings.evidence: First-price CLV: lengthened -2.25% (95% CI -3.17% to -1.16%) (193 closes, 40 games, 35% beat; ROI -8.65% on 348); shortened +2.16% (95% CI +1.58% to +2.89%) (117, 74% beat; ROI +11.78% on 200); same +0.84% (95% CI +0.29% to +1.39%) (373). CLV at the LAST price: lengthened +0.90%, shortened -0.38%. Halves: lengthened -2.95%|-1.22%, shortened +1.79%|+2.67%, same +0.15%|+1.55%. Inside 6 h only: lengthened -0.25% (51), same +1.65% (158), shortened +2.42% (47).
findings.effect: lengthened -3.08 pts vs unchanged; shortened +1.33 pts vs unchanged
findings.luck_risk: Low for the sign (it follows from Novig's price tracking the fair, slope 0.86), but it is known only afterwards: it cannot be used to choose bets at the first look, only to decide whether to add or wait after a move.

findings.claim: Long-listed bets are traps, but only the early-listed ones; the long-life effect is not separate from the 6 h effect.
findings.evidence: CLV by listedMin (c/v-listed bets): <1 min +2.45% (38 closes/15 games); 1-5 min +0.84% (46 closes/30 games); 5-30 min +0.26% (95 closes/38 games); 30-120 min +1.23% (76 closes/30 games); 120-360 min +0.28% (165 closes/31 games); 360+ min -1.38% (144 closes/24 games); by number of looks: 1 +2.73% (32); 2-3 +0.38% (93); 4-7 +0.08% (143); 8-15 +0.86% (118); 16-39 +0.46% (130); 40+ -0.98% (167). Controlled: among bets first seen 12 h or more out, lived 6 h or more vs shorter: -1.44 pts (-2.54 pts to -0.29 pts; 177 vs 152 closes, 30 games); by half -1.24 pts (156/125) | -2.58 pts (21/27). Beyond 6 h, bets that were finally dropped by the scan: -1.38% (103 closes) vs still listed at the last look -0.27% (324); within 6 h: +1.47% vs +1.32% (no difference). Within 6 h life length does not matter: <5m +1.33% (81), 5-60m +1.58% (103), 1-6h +1.27% (71).
findings.effect: long-lived vs short-lived (first look >=12 h): -1.44 pts (CI -2.54 pts to -0.29 pts)
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: sign repeats on both halves but the second half has 21 vs 27 closes; 'listed 6 h or more' needs the future, so it is a description of why early bets lose, not a rule.

findings.claim: EV rising or falling across the looks is not a usable trap sign once the first-look EV and the time to start are known.
findings.evidence: Lifetime EV change (last minus first listed EV, 0.3 pt dead band): fell +0.53% (193 closes, 41 games, first EV +2.19%), rose -0.42% (194, first EV +0.82%), flat +0.37% (296); inside 6 h +1.47%, +1.45%, +1.35%. Regression of (CLV minus first EV) on the EV change: slope 0.02 (CI -0.35 to 0.29). The reason is that Novig's price moves with the fair, so EV stays flat while price and fair move together; the fair's own change is what predicts the close (slope 0.90).
findings.luck_risk: High that there is nothing here at this sample: all three CIs include 0 and the group differences vanish inside 6 h.

findings.claim: A bet that is dropped from the list soon after the first look is not clearly a trap, and one that survives is not clearly a gift: first-price CLV of survivors vs dropped bets differs by less than +-1 pt with intervals of +-1.5 pts.
findings.evidence: Share still listed after a delay from the first look (of those observed), and first-price CLV listed minus dropped: 5 min: 70% listed (1303 vs 547 dropped, 0 unobserved), CLV listed -0.09% vs dropped +0.56%, diff -0.65 pts [-1.73 pts, +0.58 pts] on 509/128 closes; 15 min: 54% listed (846 vs 707 dropped, 236 unobserved), CLV listed +0.26% vs dropped -0.44%, diff +0.70 pts [-0.24 pts, +1.84 pts] on 359/180 closes; 30 min: 43% listed (533 vs 718 dropped, 413 unobserved), CLV listed +0.27% vs dropped -0.58%, diff +0.85 pts [-0.03 pts, +1.68 pts] on 189/201 closes; 60 min: 35% listed (387 vs 722 dropped, 450 unobserved), CLV listed +0.18% vs dropped -0.26%, diff +0.44 pts [-0.83 pts, +1.40 pts] on 159/195 closes; 120 min: 34% listed (369 vs 720 dropped, 371 unobserved), CLV listed -0.73% vs dropped +0.01%, diff -0.75 pts [-1.97 pts, +0.38 pts] on 194/170 closes; 240 min: 25% listed (197 vs 586 dropped, 414 unobserved), CLV listed -1.03% vs dropped -1.50%, diff +0.47 pts [-1.20 pts, +2.01 pts] on 101/131 closes.
findings.effect: diff between -0.75 and +0.85 pts at every delay, every CI includes 0
findings.luck_risk: High that the data cannot see a survival effect; 'unobserved' (the app stopped logging, 0 to 450 bets by delay) is excluded, so survival is itself censored.

findings.claim: Liquidity: most bets keep their dollars for hours, but a growing minority lose them; at the first look the median Novig depth is about $60-90 in every first-look bucket except 30-60 min ($26).
findings.evidence: Dollars at the first look vs later (bets still listed, same quote; ratio of dollars after the delay to dollars at the first look): 5 min: n 1384, median 1.00x, quartiles 1.00x-1.00x, fewer 13%, more 5%, price unchanged 94%; 15 min: n 855, median 1.00x, quartiles 1.00x-1.00x, fewer 25%, more 8%, price unchanged 90%; 30 min: n 539, median 1.00x, quartiles 0.88x-1.00x, fewer 37%, more 11%, price unchanged 84%; 60 min: n 389, median 1.00x, quartiles 0.57x-1.00x, fewer 42%, more 14%, price unchanged 81%; 120 min: n 369, median 1.00x, quartiles 0.58x-1.00x, fewer 44%, more 15%, price unchanged 78%; 360 min: n 129, median 0.85x, quartiles 0.22x-2.56x, fewer 61%, more 33%, price unchanged 47%. Median available at first look by first-look bucket: <30m $64, 30-60m $26, 1-3h $60, 3-6h $75, 6-12h $90, 12-24h $92, >24h $64; quartiles of CLV by available dollars are flat (-0.08%, +0.50%, +0.30%, +0.05%). Inside 6 h: median $58, IQR $19 to $264; 53% of those bets show $50 or more and 40% $100 or more.
findings.effect: no CLV gradient in dollars; 13%->44% of bets thinner after 5->120 min
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: 'dollars' is the dollars at the CURRENT price level, so a repricing resets it; the decay shares include repricing.

findings.claim: Bidding for a better price on a bet first seen within 6 h (take it only if the price later improves by 1% or more while still listed) buys +2.3% CLV on about 12% of those bets, but it is thin and is a stake question, not a replacement for taking the first price.
findings.evidence: Within 6 h: LIMIT 1%: 108 bets (12% of 938, about 48 a day), 51 closes/25 games, CLV +2.27% (95% CI +1.35% to +3.81%) vs -0.26% at their first price; halves +2.20% (11) | +2.29% (40); ROI at the improved price +11.64% on 105. 0.5% threshold: 166 bets, 72 closes, CLV +2.17%. Over all bets (any lead time): 1% threshold 406 bets, 193 closes, CLV +0.83% (95% CI -0.17% to +2.10%) vs -1.83% at first. The improved price exists only while the bet still passes the list's filters, so it is selected for a still-positive EV, which is how the app would see it live.
findings.luck_risk: High: 51 closes in 25 games, the interval's low end is +1.35 pts but it comes from selecting on the future of a price series; about 150 closes (about 4-5 more days at the 22 closes a day this group produced) would settle it.

findings.claim: The study cannot say anything about bets listed more than 24 h out, and a very early first look is mostly a backlog.
findings.evidence: 331 bets (16% of all) were first seen more than 24 h before their games but only 15 have a close (5 games, CLV -5.07%, CI -6.50% to -0.31%); their closes arrive as the Oct 6-12 games finish. The bets seen in the study's first 6 hours are listings that already existed (left-truncated first looks): 718 bets on Oct 3 are 71% early, and the late-minus-early gap falls to +1.16 pts (-0.46 pts to +2.91 pts) without them.
findings.luck_risk: Cannot be judged; the next file settles it (roughly 300 more closes for this bucket).

candidate_rules.name: Take the first listed price once inside 360 min (ENTER_360)
candidate_rules.expr: (df.minToStartFirst <= 360) | (df.lastListedMinToStart <= 360)   # bet SET only (listed at some look inside the window; wide-only bets have a NaN lastListedMinToStart so this undercounts); the price taken is the first look inside the window, code in the rationale
candidate_rules.rationale:
What a guard that waits for the window and then takes the first listed price does (code, W = 360):
W = 360   # minutes before the start (360, 180, 30 ...)
L = looks(df); P = L[L.american.notna() & (L.minToStart >= 0)].copy()   # price looks (kinds c, w, v, k)
imp = lambda a: np.where(a > 0, 100/(a+100), -a/(-a+100))
P['p'] = imp(P.american)
enter = P[P.minToStart <= W].groupby('id').head(1).set_index('id')            # W = 360: first listed price once inside the window
x = df.set_index('id').join(enter[['p']].rename(columns={'p':'p_pol'}), how='inner')
x['clv_pol'] = x.closeFair / x.p_pol - 1                                      # CLV at that price
x['profit_pol'] = np.where(x.status=='WON', 1/x.p_pol - 1, np.where(x.status=='LOST', -1.0, np.nan))
Result: 1225 bets (543 a day), 422 closes, 67 games, CLV +0.88% (95% CI +0.54% to +1.30%); the same bets taken at their first look +0.40%, so waiting gains +0.47 pts (+0.21 pts to +0.77 pts); date-balanced halves CLV +0.28% (182) | +1.33% (240), gain +0.69 pts | +0.31 pts; ROI at that price +3.23% on 1173; unit-stake CLV total on the closes 3.7u vs FIRST 1.3u. The code reproduces the engine's counts to within 1 bet.

candidate_rules.name: Wait until 30 min before the start, take it only if still listed at a price at least the first
candidate_rules.expr: df.minToStartFirst >= 30   # the set that has something to wait for; the rest are taken at their first look
candidate_rules.rationale: Pandas: pa = price looks per bet; T = 30; p_T = price of the last non-dropped look with minToStart >= T and minToStart - T <= 10 (a look no older than 10 min), valid only if the bet is still listed (no 'x' look after it); take p_T if p_T <= p_first (price at least as good) else skip; bets whose first look is already inside T are taken at their first look. Result: 495 bets kept of 2080, 125 closes, 48 games, CLV +1.15% (95% CI +0.53% to +1.94%) vs +0.41% at first look (gain +0.73 pts, CI +0.13 pts to +1.36 pts); total CLV units lower than FIRST's. Not recommended: it throws away three quarters of the bets for +0.7 pts on the survivors.

candidate_rules.name: Within 6 h, add a second bet if the price improves 1% or more while the bet is still listed
candidate_rules.expr: df.minToStartFirst <= 360   # the set; the add-on needs the looks, code in the rationale
candidate_rules.rationale: Pandas: P = price looks as above; P['p0'] = P.groupby('id').p.transform('first'); P['i0'] = P.groupby('id').cumcount(); fill = P[(P.i0 > 0) & (P.p <= P.p0*0.99)].groupby('id').head(1) restricted to bets with df.minToStartFirst <= 360; clv = closeFair / fill.p - 1. Result: 108 bets (48 a day), 51 closes, 25 games, CLV +2.27% (95% CI +1.35% to +3.81%) at the improved price vs -0.26% at the first price; halves +2.20% (11) | +2.29% (40); median Novig dollars at the improved price $108. It is a question for Tj (more exposure on one bet), too thin as a rule.

app_changes_implied: PROPOSAL, no change: keep TrapGuard.DEFAULT_EARLY_HOURS = 6 (data/scanner/TrapGuard.kt) and the lists' Starts within = 6h (ScanSettings.startsWithinHours, STARTS_WITHIN_CHOICES). The study's 683 closes (229 of them Tracker reads of bets Tj placed, 454 not) reproduce the §82 step: first look within 6 h +1.41% (256 closes, 66 games), beyond -0.54% (427 closes, 31 games), gap +1.95 pts (CI +1.05 to +2.96), and inside the same game +2.62 pts (28 games). Do not widen it to 12 or 24 h: the 6-12 h bets are about 0 (+0.19%, 98 closes) and 12-24 h negative.

PROPOSAL, no change: do not add a 'wait for the best price' step inside the window. Inside 6 h the LAST price is -0.06 pts vs the first (CI -0.28 to +0.25), delays of 5/15/30 min move CLV by -0.02 to +0.08 pts (60 min +0.74 pts on 27 closes), and only the hindsight BEST price (+0.69 pts) helps. Taking the first price once the bet enters the 6 h window is what the guard does and it gained +0.47 pts over the first look on the bets it keeps (CI +0.21 to +0.77).

QUESTION FOR TJ (stake, not a safety limit): the guard skips the early look and takes the bet at its first look inside 6 h; if the price then improves by 1% or more while the bet still passes every filter, the improved price closed +2.27% (51 closes, 25 games, CI +1.35 to +3.81) vs -0.26% for the first price on the same bets. Whether to add a second, small bet there (the AutoBettor would need to allow one add-on per bet, at most once, still under the daily limit and price tolerance) is his call; about 150 closes would settle it, which is about 4-5 more days at the 22 closes a day this group produced (48 fills a day, fewer with a close).

QUESTION FOR TJ, only if he ever wants bets earlier than 6 h (EARLY_CHOICES 12/24): size them on the EV minus the observed shortfall, not on the shown EV: CLV minus listed EV is about -1.0 to -1.2 pts at 6-12 h and -2.2 pts at 12-24 h (vs -0.1 to -0.2 pts in the <30 min, 1-3 h and 3-6 h buckets; 30-60 min -1.3 pts on 33 closes), and a 4%+ listed EV beyond 12 h shows +1.1% on 26 bets (CI -3.0 to +5.0%), so no EV exception to the guard is supported.

PROPOSAL (logging only): implement the items under next_logging in data/.../study/ (ScanStudy, StudyJournal) so the 6 h cut (3 h? 9 h?) and the price-improvement rule can be settled by about 300 early-listed closes and 150 improved-price closes.

Log scan-off gaps (app closed, phone asleep, token expired) as their own look kind so 'unobserved' can be excluded; today 25 bets per hundred (413 of 1664) are neither listed nor dropped at a 30-minute delay.
